entities.summary: Engey is the second largest island of the Kollafjörður fjord in western Iceland. The name Engey is composed of eng and ey (island). Engey is the second-largest island on the southeastern side of the Kollafjörður fjord after Viðey. The government bought the island from its last inhabitant after World War II. Ownership was later transferred to the city of Reykjavík in 1978.
